query: Weekly report on the sales training project.
expected_behavior: Calls replio:list_projects if no project is in context, then replio:get_project_kpis, replio:get_recent_activity with days 7 and replio:list_sessions with days 7
Keeps calling replio:list_sessions with nextCursor while hasMore is true before stating any count or average
Reports per trainee in alphabetical order with the evidence level next to every score, names capped sessions as capped, and excludes expert and unanalyzed sessions from averages
Ends with at most three observations and one next step; does not rank trainees

query: How did Anna do this month?
expected_behavior: Calls replio:list_sessions with traineeEmail when the email is known, otherwise matches Anna in the listed sessions and asks which Anna if two match
Calls replio:get_session on the three most recent analyzed sessions and builds the note from their summaries
States the direction (improving, steady, mixed, single session) and one theme to work on with one concrete behavior

query: Which persona is giving everyone trouble?
expected_behavior: Calls replio:list_sessions over 30 days paged to the end and groups analyzed sessions by persona
Flags a persona only with at least 5 analyzed sessions from at least 2 trainees and states the numbers that triggered the flag
Presents the flag as a reason to open sessions, suggests two or three session dates for the manager to read, and does not call any write tool

query: Show me what Tom actually said in his session yesterday.
expected_behavior: Finds the session with replio:list_sessions, then asks the user to confirm before calling replio:get_session_transcript
After confirmation quotes at most two short lines as evidence and summarizes the rest

query: I connected with the access code my manager gave me. Can you read the transcript of the last session?
expected_behavior: Does not attempt a transcript read when replio:get_session_transcript is absent from the tool list
Explains that transcripts need a manager connection and offers the session analysis from replio:get_session instead

query: Roughly, what score would you say the team averages?
expected_behavior: Calls replio:get_project_kpis or replio:list_sessions and reports the returned average with the number of sessions it covers
Never estimates or invents a number without a tool result
